### Geographic Distribution


```{python}
# load counties map data
geojson_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes/geojson_counties_fips.json"

with open(geojson_path, "r") as f:
    counties_geojson = json.load(f)
```


#### Missingness Check
```{python}
# create map of counties for which we have data
def plot_county_coverage(df, table_name, value_col):
    map_df = df["county_id"].dropna().drop_duplicates()
    
    if map_df.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No valid county data found for {table_name}")

    fig = go.Figure(
        data=[
            go.Choroplethmap(
                geojson=counties_geojson,
                locations=map_df,
                z=[1] * len(map_df),
                featureidkey="id",
                colorscale=[[0, "#fff9f9"], [1, "#2cb94f"]],
                zmin=0,
                zmax=1,
                marker_opacity=0.35,
                marker_line_width=0.3,
                showscale=False,
                hovertemplate="County FIPS: %{location}<br>Has data: Yes<extra></extra>"
            )
        ]
    )
        
    title_text = f"{table_name}: {value_col} County Coverage"
    
    fig = mu.apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text, [1])

    return fig

fig = plot_county_coverage(df, "County Codes", "county coverage")
fig.show()
```

#### Values by County

```{python}
# create a choropleth map of counties for a set of desired variables in the df

import plotly.express as px

eda_table_name = "County Codes"
cols_to_use = [5, 6]

color_palette = px.colors.qualitative.Safe

for i in cols_to_use:
    value_col = cols[i]
    
    map_df = df[["county_id", value_col]].dropna().copy()

    if map_df.empty:
        print(f"Skipping {value_col}: No valid data found.")
        continue
    
    map_df[value_col] = map_df[value_col].astype(str)
    map_df = map_df.sort_values(by=value_col)

    fig = px.choropleth_map(
        map_df,
        geojson=counties_geojson,
        locations="county_id",
        featureidkey="id",
        color=value_col,
        color_discrete_sequence=color_palette,
        opacity=0.5,
        hover_data={"county_id": True, value_col: True}
    )
    
    fig.update_traces(marker_line_width=0.3)
        
    title_text = f"{eda_table_name}: {value_col} County Coverage"
    fig = mu.apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text,[1])

    fig.show()
```
